decision: Field instruments and control valves are wired 4-20 mA with HART (asset management through HART multiplexing in the DCS I/O); no PROFIBUS PA or FOUNDATION Fieldbus. Discrete signals 24 V DC. Packages communicate by Modbus TCP or OPC UA over redundant links, MV protection relays by IEC 61850. SIS signals are hard-wired.
rationale: Single I/O technology for BOP, IEC turbine control interface and packages; simpler commissioning and maintenance by the Owner's staff; no fieldbus segment design and diagnostics needed.
title: Field signal philosophy: 4-20 mA HART, no field bus
